title: Thirteen Pressings and One Scratched Groove
subtitle: 音乐与唱片 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 音乐与唱片（文学艺术与体育·音乐与唱片）
meta: 主题语境：音乐与唱片（文学艺术与体育·音乐与唱片）　|　核心词汇：disc　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 disc 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 the producer ① cut a disc that no label in the city would have issued, and he said the cutting was the whole of the session. The ② disc, meaning the record and not the shape, ran thirteen pressings and stayed unsold in the shop; a disc, he said, is the only thing in a studio that is judged by how long it is left unplayed.

Every ③ disc in that shop had the same scratched groove across it, and the ④ disc at the end, meaning the one they kept for the radio and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever played twice. A disc, his engineer said, is nine parts groove and one part somebody willing to cut; the producer said the groove is the part that fills thirteen pressings.

The geometer meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the disc was the whole of the figure, meaning the shape and not the record. The ⑥ disc, meaning the shape and not any of that, is the only thing in a figure that everybody draws and nobody measures; disc, she said, is either something you cut or the only word that means both a record and a shape. She said the shape is the part they remember.

By 1957 the ⑦ disc had become a line in a catalogue, and the catalogue had become an argument about the scratched groove. The ⑧ disc of the whole thing, the producer wrote in February, was one studio and thirteen pressings of cutting; disc, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to cut. She said the cutting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ disc I remember is the one at the end, which was reissued in 1970 and is still described as the strangest in the shop. A ⑩ disc, the engineer said in 1972, is the only thing that improves by being played; every disc, she said, is a shape that has agreed to look like a record. She said the shape was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 唱片；碟片（指店里摆着的那一张）
B. n. 唱片（指那张碟片本身，与那个圆盘形相对）
C. 固定搭配：cut a disc 录制（刻制）一张唱片
D. n. 唱片（指留给电台用的那一张）
E. n. 唱片；碟（抽象总称，指一间录音室的全部唱片）
F. n. 唱片（指目录上写到、被列名的那一张）
G. n. 圆盘；圆形的平面（指图形里画出的那个）
H. n. 圆盘（抽象总称，指人人画却无人测量的那个）

items.q: cut a disc that no label in the city would have issued
The disc, meaning the record and not the shape
the disc was the whole of the figure
the disc had become a line in a catalogue
The disc of the whole thing
A disc, the engineer said in 1972

answers.why: cut a disc 意为“录制（刻制）一张唱片”，1949 年制作人录制了一张全城没有一家唱片公司肯发行的唱片。
disc 意为“唱片”，指那张碟片本身而不是那个圆盘形，它压了十三版而在店里没有卖出。
disc 意为“唱片”，指那家店里每一张唱片，每一张上面都横着同一道划伤的纹槽。
disc 意为“唱片”，指留给电台用的那一张，是唯一有人放过两次的。
disc 意为“圆盘、圆形的平面”，指图形里画出的那个，几何学家说这个圆盘就是那个图形的全部。
disc 意为“圆盘”，指人人画却无人测量的那个而不是那张碟片，是图形里人人都画、却无人测量的东西。
disc 意为“唱片”，指目录上写到、被列名的那一张，到 1957 年这张唱片成了目录里的一行。
disc 意为“唱片、碟”，制作人二月写道，整件事的唱片是一间录音室和十三版的刻制。
disc 意为“唱片”，我记得的是末尾那一张，1970 年重新发行，至今仍被说成店里最奇的一张。
disc 为抽象总称，录音师 1972 年说，一张唱片是唯一会因为被播放而变得更好的东西。
